cuenca.name: Cuenca
cuenca.lede: Airport pickups, rides to the coast and drivers by the hour, all private and door to door.
facts: Mariscal Lamar (CUE), 3 km from the historic center
local: A small airport, a short ride
Mariscal Lamar sits inside the city. Most hotels in El Centro are 10 to 15 minutes away, and your driver waits at the arrivals exit with your name on a sign.
The road to the coast crosses Cajas
Going to Guayaquil, Salinas or Montañita you climb past 4,000 m at Tres Cruces before dropping to sea level. Bring a light jacket, and tell your driver if you get carsick on curvy roads.
Stops are part of the ride
Want a few minutes at the Cajas lagoons or lunch on the way? Ask when you book or tell the driver on the day.
faq: How far is Cuenca Airport from the historic center?
About 3 km. The ride usually takes 10 to 15 minutes, a little more at rush hour.
Can you pick me up at my Airbnb, not a hotel?
Yes. Write the exact address when you book and we pick you up at the door.
Do you go to Guayaquil Airport directly?
Yes. Most of our Cuenca to Guayaquil rides end at the airport. Give us your flight time and we plan the departure so you arrive with time to spare.
Is the drive over Cajas safe?
It is a paved highway our drivers cover every week. Fog can roll in, so we drive it with time to spare and never rush.

guayaquil.name: Guayaquil
guayaquil.lede: From José Joaquín de Olmedo Airport to the beaches, the Andes or your hotel downtown.
facts: José Joaquín de Olmedo (GYE), next to the city
local: Your driver waits at the arrivals exit with a name sign, so you skip the taxi line.
Salinas is about 2 hours away and Montañita under 3, so you can land in the morning and be on the sand by lunch.
The ride to Cuenca climbs from sea level to more than 4,000 m. Take it slow on your first day up high.
faq: Send us your flight number when you book and we adjust the pickup if it lands early or late.
Can you take us from the airport straight to Cuenca?
Yes, that is our most popular ride. The driver meets you at arrivals and you go straight up through Cajas.

quito.name: Quito
quito.lede: Private rides from Mariscal Sucre Airport and day transfers to Cotopaxi, Mindo, Papallacta and beyond.
facts: Mariscal Sucre (UIO), in Tababela, 45 to 60 min from the city
local: Quito's airport is in Tababela, east of the city. A pre-booked ride saves you the late-night taxi negotiation after a long flight.
Cotopaxi, Papallacta and Mindo are all day-trip distance, and we can drop you at a hacienda or lodge on the way.
faq: How long is the ride from Quito Airport to the Old Town?
Usually 45 to 60 minutes, longer at evening rush hour.
Can you stop at Cotopaxi on the way to Baños?
Yes. Tell us when you book and we plan the extra time.
